verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents running its agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or on any agent-server backend. It offers a free local edition with web GUI, terminal UI and CLI, an open-source Agent Canvas client, and an Agent Server package you operate yourself. Licensed self-hosting is available through Enterprise. missing for 10: detailed self-host deployment/installation guide in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting, clarity on which enterprise features require a commercial license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or anywhere you can run an agent server backend
Free, local OpenHands for getting started ... Best-in-class OpenHands Agent ... Web-based GUI, Terminal UI, and CLI
OpenHands Enterprise provides commercial capabilities and support for organizations that need licensed self-hosting or managed deployment options.
The Agent Server package (`openhands-agent-server`) runs the OpenHands Software Agent SDK behind an HTTP and WebSocket API.
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
